decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings

Condition : 4 - Details of any new openings for services, water and waste disposal and ventilation to include materials, at 1:20 scale, shall be submitted by the consent holder to the Local Planning Authority and approved before the commencement of works.
description: Listed building consent for works to the exterior of the building including alterations to the access arrangements including a new doorway and the installation of solar hot water panels; extensive works to the interior including new doors, partitions, drainage and changes to the floors.
